session_click_mapping.basis: Documented training-only median positive content-navigation weekly total. This is a synthetic increment, not a measured session length or causal effect.
session_click_mapping.mapping_rule: A Search allocation increments only the selected activity group's click feature in its configured assessment-relative window; preserve all other features and source rows.

allocation_bounds.basis: No numeric bounds proposed. They need independent justification; do not infer 0..3 from weekly capacity 3.

slot_catalog_proposal.course_week_anchor: Synthetic week 0 begins Monday 00:00 UTC; this is not an OULAD calendar date.
slot_catalog_proposal.week_index_expansion: Expand each of the three weekday windows for every listed course week, yielding 42 stable unique slot IDs.
slot_catalog_proposal.availability_statement: Generated slots are a planning scenario, not observed or asserted student calendar availability.
slot_catalog_proposal.assignment_relative_window_mapping: Independently of CSP eligibility, map a complete slot interval to one of the four NN click-history windows [D-28,D-21), [D-21,D-14), [D-14,D-7), [D-7,D), when it fits. A deadline-eligible slot outside these windows has no NN click-history mapping.

deadline_eligibility_proposal.rule: A session slot is eligible only when its complete local-time interval ends before the configured deadline boundary. This is independent of the four NN click-history windows.
deadline_eligibility_proposal.boundary_note: The professor specifies that a session must come before its assignment deadline but does not define whether the deadline day is inclusive. Current implementation assumption: deadline day D begins at 00:00 on course-relative day D and the whole slot must end strictly before it. A slot ending exactly at D 00:00 is excluded. This conservative boundary is an implementation assumption, not a professor-specified rule. The synthetic week-0 Monday anchor and UTC identity remain proposed generated choices requiring approval.

same_assignment_ordering.relation: Successive sessions for the same assignment must be strictly chronological by (course week index, weekday offset from the synthetic week anchor, local start minute).
same_assignment_ordering.implication: Multiple same-week sessions are allowed only when their start times are strictly ordered; the policy is implemented but its proposed calendar remains subject to approval.

support_policy.basis: Proposed disposition keeps marginal out-of-range predictions visible with warnings; it does not claim joint support.
